slope.processing: Native elevation windows; bilinear reprojection to a metre-based 10 m NAD83 UTM grid; central-difference slope in degrees; 0-90 degree check before thresholding; rectangle extending 3 km past each edge of the fire's projected bounding box; nearest-neighbor class rendering to Web Mercator PNG. Water and no-data transparent.
slope.limitation: Elevation editions are not fire-date measurements. Display is resampled; no extra spatial detail is created. Census water is not date-matched; invalid water polygons are omitted and listed in the water source record. This is terrain, not a watershed or a debris-flow estimate.
